notes: AI Agent Ecosystem 0.4.0 uses one GitHub repository as the canonical source and generates native adapters for Codex, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and Cursor.
The Antigravity adapter remains backward-compatible at plugin version 0.3.2; root plugin.json is intentionally not bumped with the ecosystem release.
Canonical agent role instructions remain in modules/*/agents/*.md; platform-specific runtime tool sections are stripped when generating non-Antigravity profiles.
All 19 reusable Agent Skills are copied into each adapter's native skill directory; Cursor uses .cursor/skills/ and source skill content remains canonical under modules/*/skills/.
Project-local memory remains in the target project's .agent-ecosystem directory and is shared through existing JSON/Markdown contracts.
Native adapters do not grant host permissions. Runtime tools, approval policies, sandboxing, MCP connectivity, and delegation must be verified in each runtime and surface.

Installers preserve existing instruction content through managed blocks where the host format allows it; Cursor uses a dedicated exclusively managed MDC rule. Unmanaged conflicting files are never overwritten.

modules.description: Shared behavioral standards for specialist agents, including simplicity, scoped changes, explicit assumptions, and evidence-based completion.
Plans product and system architecture, defines module boundaries, records technical decisions, and decomposes approved scope into owned implementation tasks.
Designs and implements backend domain logic, APIs, persistence, validation, integrations, authorization, and backend tests against approved architecture.
Portable skills for product discovery, architecture, task planning, API and data design, TDD, debugging, review, and verification.
Designs and implements frontend application structure, accessible UI, state management, API integration, and frontend tests against approved design and contracts.
Designs and implements cloud infrastructure, environments, CI/CD, deployment configuration, secrets integration, observability, and operational readiness.
Creates independent test strategies, validates acceptance criteria, tests critical user journeys, and reports reproducible defects and release risks.
Compose project teams from specialist agents, create dependency-aware task plans, coordinate handoffs, and maintain persistent project memory and session continuity.
Researches user needs, designs user journeys and information architecture, defines interaction patterns, and produces implementation-ready design specifications.
